title: Snap a Photo to Instantly Know the Lowest Price: China-Market Apple AI Starts Beta Testing and Integrates with Dewu App
excerpt: On the evening of November 4, the mainland China version of Apple Intelligence officially began its Beta test, with core features such as Visual Intelligence op
content_html:
On the evening of November 4, the mainland China version of Apple Intelligence officially began its Beta test, with core features such as Visual Intelligence opening at the same time. As one of the first apps in the Chinese market to integrate this feature, Dewu App has achieved deep integration with the iPhone at the system level, marking a key step forward in the practical implementation of on-device AI in vertical e-commerce scenarios.

After this integration, users can invoke Visual Intelligence through the camera on an iPhone that supports the feature, and simply photograph a product in real life to connect directly to the Dewu platform. The system can automatically recognize it and provide full-chain information such as related product search, detailed views, historical price trends, in-depth AI analysis, and genuine user reviews, offering structured reference for consumers' purchasing decisions. Tapping the search result even takes users directly to the corresponding product detail page in the Dewu App, creating an efficient closed loop from image recognition and price comparison to platform redirection.

As an app that was previously among the first to support iPhone Duo large-screen optimization, Dewu has now further extended product search and information services to the underlying system. Industry analysts believe that as the mainland China Apple Intelligence Beta test rolls out fully, the integration of on-device large models with the vertical e-commerce ecosystem is moving from concept into deep real-world scenarios. Visual Intelligence not only shortens users' consumer decision-making journey, but also opens up a new entry-point traffic and intelligent interaction paradigm for e-commerce platforms.
